description: Travel search API for flights, hotels, and car rentals. Each result lists every seller with a price and booking URL. Search returns a token; results and details read it.
rules: Send the API key as the X-API-Key header from a server, never from browser JavaScript.
A search returns searchToken, not results. Read results with GET /{vertical}/results?token=..., and details with the same token plus resultId.
Hotels and cars need a locationId from GET /hotels/locations or GET /cars/locations. A place name on the search is rejected.
Ask the user for missing places or dates instead of guessing. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and cannot be in the past.
There is no currency field. Send country to pick the market; prices come back in that country's currency.
Filter ids come from availableFilters on a results page: airlines for flights, bookingSites (as providers) for hotels and cars, agency (as agencies) for cars.
Return providerUrl to the user exactly as the API gave it. Ktemia compares prices; it does not book.
